description: Re-introduces the index/id confusion: the checkbox handler receives the row's index within the *visible* list and looks that index up in the full todos array. Under the 'active' filter the 2nd visible row (t3) toggles full-array index 1 (t2, already completed), so t3 stays visible and t2 becomes active. Trips critical toggle-by-id-under-active-filter (expects 3 rows, still sees 4). With filter 'all' indices coincide, so the other tests pass.
